The '''YV-929 light freighter''' was a variant of the [[YV-929 armed freighter]].

==Characteristics==
Despite having a noticeably lighter armament than the armed freighter model, it retained enough firepower to arouse suspicions among military patrols and customs inspectors in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. However those same weapons made it very popular in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Also many mercenary units favored it, often modifying the vessels to increase their weapon loadouts.<ref name="DC" />
